title: Reliable background music start via user-gesture recovery, readiness/error states, and blocked-autoplay prompt

requirements.summary: Make background music reliably start after the first user gesture when autoplay is blocked, and keep playback stable across stage transitions and toggle changes.
acceptanceCriteria: With music enabled, after a fresh page load on a browser that blocks autoplay, the first user gesture (click/tap anywhere on the page, including pressing Yes/No) starts the audio within 1 second.
If playback is blocked initially, the app registers a user-gesture listener (e.g., pointerdown/touchend/keydown) that re-attempts audio.play() and then removes itself once playback succeeds.
Playback continues looping across stage transitions (question -> celebration) without restarting unexpectedly.
If the user toggles music OFF, audio pauses immediately; toggling ON triggers a play attempt and, if blocked, waits for the next user gesture to start.

file_operations.description: Refactor background music management to (1) attempt play when enabled, (2) detect autoplay blocking and register document-level user-gesture listeners (pointerdown/touchend/keydown) that retry play and self-remove on success, (3) ensure toggle OFF pauses immediately and toggle ON attempts play then falls back to waiting for the next gesture, and (4) avoid restarting audio across UI stage changes by keeping a single looping Audio instance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the updated useBackgroundMusic hook outputs into the page so that interactions (including Yes/No clicks) naturally count as user gestures for the global listener, and ensure the hook stays mounted for both stages so the loop continues without unexpected restarts. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add explicit audio loading/readiness and error states so failures to load/decode the static MP3 are surfaced in the UI and readiness does not rely only on canplaythrough.
acceptanceCriteria: If the audio file fails to load (network error/404/decode), the app sets a distinct error state (not just console noise) and does not keep waiting on canplaythrough indefinitely.
The music control UI communicates a clear English status when audio is unavailable (e.g., "Audio failed to load") and the toggle does not misleadingly imply that music is playing.

Audio readiness does not rely solely on the canplaythrough event; readiness becomes true when the browser indicates playable state (e.g., canplay/loadeddata/readyState) so playback can start on slower networks/devices.

file_operations.description: Implement richer audio lifecycle state: track loading/readiness using multiple signals (loadeddata/canplay and readyState polling/inspection), and set a distinct error state on audio error/decode failures and on a reasonable load timeout to prevent indefinite waiting; ensure the hook exposes UI-consumable status text/state so the app can display "Audio failed to load" when the asset at /assets/audio/glue-song-sped-up-pitched.mp3 cannot be used. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend the header music control UI to reflect audio status in clear English (e.g., unavailable/error/blocked/playing/paused) while keeping the existing toggle accessible with English aria-labels; ensure the UI does not imply music is playing when the hook reports an error/unavailable state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Pass audio status from useBackgroundMusic into Header so the top-level music control can communicate failures (e.g., "Audio failed to load") and avoid misleading state when playback cannot start. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an unobtrusive, accessible on-screen prompt when music is enabled but blocked by autoplay policy, offering a direct action to start playback.
acceptanceCriteria: When music is enabled and the app detects it needs a user gesture to start (autoplay blocked), an on-screen prompt appears in English (e.g., "Tap to enable sound") and is keyboard-accessible.
Tapping/clicking the prompt triggers a play attempt; once playback succeeds, the prompt disappears.
The existing header music toggle remains present and accessible (aria-labels remain in English), and the new prompt does not break layout on mobile.

file_operations.description: Expose a dedicated imperative "play now" action (in addition to toggle) and a stable "needsUserGesture"/blocked state derived from failed play attempts, so the UI prompt can trigger retries and hide immediately once playback succeeds. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an unobtrusive, mobile-safe, keyboard-accessible prompt UI (using existing composed UI building blocks, without editing immutable ui components) that appears only when music is enabled and autoplay is blocked; clicking/pressing the prompt calls the hook's play action, and the prompt disappears once playback starts. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
